title: Changes in Amino Acid Absorption After Adding a Probiotic to an Acute Protein Feeding
official: Comparative Differences of Amino Acid Appearance with Milk Protein Ingestion with and Without Probiotic Supplementation
summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the rate and concentration of amino acid absorption after a three-week pattern of milk protein supplementation with and without the addition of a single strain probiotic.
